picks.editorial_note: Fermilab was selected to lead a DOE Genesis Mission initiative applying AI to control and optimize particle accelerator performance — a flagship national program signaling how the federal government is directing AI investment toward core physical science infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A £5 million UK government-backed trial will use AI-driven flight path adjustments to cut aviation's contrail-driven climate impact — a rare case of AI research moving directly into a real-world, government-funded climate intervention.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants exceeding $42 million, building national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure that will underpin research well beyond a single institution.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9 million NSF-funded iDLab will unify browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advancing the federal NAIRR initiative to democratize AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are combining AI tools with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate discovery of new battery materials — a concrete industry-academia push on a technology critical to the energy transition.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award will apply AI to five decades of water-quality records to locate critical minerals like copper and cobalt, tying AI research to U.S. supply-chain security priorities.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs trained on massive datasets often can't be traced to specific training examples — has significant implications for ongoing AI copyright and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Smith+Nephew launched a five-year center to translate computer-vision and AI research into surgical robotics, a substantial industry commitment to clinical AI application.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo formed a new industry-academia cluster pairing an established AI drug discovery platform with biomedical research capabilities, aimed at accelerating pharmaceutical discovery pipelines.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: Stony Brook University stood up a new Department of Technology, AI and Society backed by a $5 million SUNY grant, reflecting growing institutional investment in AI's societal and governance dimensions, not just its technical development.
picks.title: Wohn Named Inaugural Chair of New Department of Technology, AI and Society - SBU News
